name: GlobeXAI - Production Trade Automation OS v2 (Sequential)

parameters.content:
## GLOBEX AI - Production Trade Automation OS v2 (Sequential)

Sequential linear chain - 0 parallel branches (one IF gate before escrow-adjacent steps).
Webhooks: globex-analyze-trade-v2 / globex-test-trade-v2

2026-08-26 update: added RAG Query v2 (Ollama-synthesized answers), Sanctions
Screen, and a real Transaction Gate that BLOCKS the chain before counterparty
match / report generation / escrow if the gate returns BLOCKED. Previously
these three compliance-hardening endpoints existed on the backend but were
never called by this workflow.
